item: B2' REOPENED — the figure convention is not a scaling choice, it is a structural coupling. ESCALATION.
status: OPEN / ESCALATED 2026-08-13. Machine B is NOT self-adjudicating this. The option-A implementation landed in 27fc71df is now SUSPECT and its +1.10 km result must not be used until this is ruled on.
why_reopened: The third reviewer pass raised a MAJOR against the implementation: the code multiplies the WHOLE (Bs - As) — a DIFFERENCE of surface and shell-base figure terms — while the docstring justifies scaling the SURFACE figure only. Investigating that from the primary source (papers/hemingway2019enceladus.pdf sections 2.3 and 2.5) shows BOTH readings are wrong about H&M's actual treatment.

what_HM_actually_do.section_2.3_Eq_12: H&M set the surface relief to the OBSERVATIONS and compute the base relief from Airy isostasy: H_b^nh = -H_t^nh (rho_ice/dRho)(g_t/g_b). The base figure is NOT hydrostatic and NOT a rescaled copy of the surface — it is the ISOSTATIC RESPONSE to the non-hydrostatic surface load, with the OPPOSITE SIGN and an amplification of rho_ice/dRho.
what_HM_actually_do.section_2.5_Eq_19_20: The libration is driven by (B-A)/C summed over layers with each layer's own (a_i, b_i, c_i) and density contrast, and Eq. 20's Ks/Kc/K_int are 'functions of moment of inertia differences (B-A) in those layers'. H&M state explicitly: 'the outer shape of the ice shell comes directly from the observations ... and the shape of the ice/ocean interface is obtained as described in section 2.3 or 2.4.' So BOTH interfaces carry non-hydrostatic figure, and the base one comes from the isostasy model.
what_HM_actually_do.consequence: The libration torque therefore depends on the COMPENSATION STATE. It is not a fixed multiplicative correction at all.

measured_at_the_fiducial_zb25_Doc36.note: The Airy root is LARGER IN MAGNITUDE than the hydrostatic base figure itself (814 m vs 668 m), which is why this is a structural effect and not a small correction.

the_decisive_new_finding.claim: The libration DOES depend on compensation_C2, contradicting the third pass's finding that dlibration/dC2 = 0.00 sigma.
the_decisive_new_finding.why_the_earlier_finding_differed: The third pass measured dlibration/dC2 with the libration on the HYDROSTATIC figure, where C2 genuinely cannot enter — the Airy root never reaches the torque. Once the base figure carries the isostatic response (H&M's actual treatment) C2 enters the libration directly. So 'the libration breaks the C2-zb degeneracy' is true ONLY in the hydrostatic formulation; under H&M's it does not, and MAJOR-4's conclusion that gravity is a pure compensation-state measurement while libration is a pure thickness channel would need revisiting.

what_this_means_and_what_it_does_not.does_not_mean: It does NOT mean the H&M treatment is right and PP is wrong. A 30-sigma discrepancy at C2=1 more plausibly indicates that my mapping of the Airy root into the triaxial (B-A) is inconsistent with how H&M assemble Eq. 19 — e.g. they may apply the isostatic root to the l=2 ORDER-2 sectoral figure with a different normalization, or their (B-A) uses the density CONTRAST at the interface rather than the layer densities I used.
does_mean: The +1.10 km figure from 27fc71df rests on a scaling (whole-difference) that matches NEITHER a surface-only reading NOR H&M's Eq. 12, so it should not be quoted as 'the H&M convention' as the config currently does.

The three candidate treatments span zb 24.7 / 25.8 / 27.34 km — 2.6 km, comparable to the 6 km H&M-vs-Park band separation the campaign exists to adjudicate. This is now the campaign's largest single unresolved systematic.
Because the libration is the SOLE thickness channel (third-pass MAJOR-4), this is not a nuisance-width question. It sets where the answer lands.

recommendation_not_a_ruling: Do NOT quote the +1.10 km. Keep the H22_obs_m kwarg (default None is byte-identical, so nothing is broken) but STOP treating the whole-difference scaling as adjudicated. The next step is not another scaling guess: it is to reproduce H&M's own Table 2 shell thicknesses from their inputs with the libration in the loop, which would discriminate the treatments against a published answer. That is the same strategy that made the B13 gravity gate trustworthy.
